technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Shell as the core framework for building the Spring Cloud Data CLI interface.
Target Spring Cloud Stream standalone Spring Boot application conventions for porting Spring XD modules.
Leverage Spring Boot `@ConfigurationProperties` metadata generation (via spring-boot-configuration-processor) to query and display configuration options in the `module info` shell command.
Implement REST client wrappers matching the Spring Cloud Data Flow REST API specifications for stream lifecycle management (create, deploy, undeploy, destroy, list).
assumptions: The underlying Spring Cloud Data REST API server endpoints are already implemented and accessible.
Existing Spring XD source code for http, tcp, twitterstream, twittersearch, filter, and transform modules is available and well-structured for migration.
Development and target execution runtime is based on Java 17+ and modern Spring Boot / Spring Cloud Stream releases.
A single developer will execute all implementation, unit testing, and integration verification tasks sequentially.

activities.activity_description: Define the metadata extraction approach using @ConfigurationProperties and design the REST client interface for the shell application (U2 requirement foundation).

activities.activity_name: Spring Cloud Data Shell & Stream Commands Implementation
activities.activity_description: Build the CLI application foundation using Spring Shell and implement REST API integrations for stream commands (create, deploy, undeploy, destroy, list) (U1).
Implement the `module info` command in the shell interface to parse and display module properties extracted via @ConfigurationProperties metadata (U2).
Port the `http` source module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream repo, updating configuration, dependencies, and unit tests (U3).
Port the `tcp` source module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream repo, including socket handling configuration and unit tests (U4).
Port the `twitterstream` source module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream repo, updating authentication properties and stream binding logic (U5).
Port the `twittersearch` source module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream repo, updating polling and REST query configuration (U6).
Port the `filter` processor module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream repo, updating SpEL evaluation bindings and unit tests (U7).
Port the `transform` processor module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream repo, updating message payload transformation logic and unit tests (U8).

activities.activity_name: Integration Testing and E2E Pipeline Verification
activities.activity_description: Perform end-to-end integration testing of shell commands against REST API, and verify pipeline deployment using ported source and processor modules.
